from.place: The assertion that the category of discrete G-modules has enough injectives, supplied by the cited functorial-embedding lemma

title: Discrete modules for a topological group have functorial injective embeddings
statement: Let $G$ be a topological group and $R$ a ring. In the category of left $R$-modules with a $G$-action by $R$-linear automorphisms such that every element has open stabilizer, and with $R$-linear $G$-equivariant maps, there is a functor $J$ and a natural transformation $j:\operatorname{id}\to J$ such that every $j_M:M\to J(M)$ is a monomorphism and every $J(M)$ is an injective object [def-sp-injective-resolutions] in this category.
